rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CALL AddCol('hdc','s_ht_control','bp',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_ht_control','target1',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_ht_control','result1',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_ht_control','bp1',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_ht_control','target2',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');

CALL AddCol('hdc','s_ht_control','no_bp_d',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_ht_control','no_bp_f',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_ht_control','bp1_d',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_ht_control','bp1_f',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_ht_control','result_bp1_d',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_ht_control','result_bp1_f',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_ht_control(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,

  target int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	bp int(9) DEFAULT 0,

  target1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	bp1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	target2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,

	no_bp_d int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	no_bp_f int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	bp1_d int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	bp1_f int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result_bp1_d int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result_bp1_f int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_ht_control WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_ht_control 
(
SELECT @id,b.hospcode,b.areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
,b.target,b.result_bp2,b.bp2,a.target,a.result_bp2,a.bp2,a.visit2
,b.no_bp,a.no_bp,b.bp1,a.bp1,b.result_bp1,a.result_bp1
FROM
(SELECT
p.check_hosp hospcode,p.check_vhid areacode
,COUNT(DISTINCT d.cid) target
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(((d.ld_bp1 NOT BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d ) OR  ISNULL(d.ld_bp1)),d.cid,NULL )) no_bp

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(d.ld_bp1 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
	AND ((d.ld_bp2  NOT BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d) OR  ISNULL(d.ld_bp2) ),d.cid,NULL )) bp1

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(d.ld_bp1 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
		AND d.ld_bp2 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d ,d.cid,NULL )) bp2

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(d.ld_bp1 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
		AND d.rs_bps1 <140 AND d.rs_bps1 >=50 AND d.rs_bpd1 <90 AND d.rs_bpd1 >=50 ,d.cid,NULL )) result_bp1

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(d.ld_bp1 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
		AND d.ld_bp2 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d AND d.control_ht IN(1),d.cid,NULL )) result_bp2
FROM
t_dmht d 
INNER JOIN t_person_cid p ON d.cid=p.CID
WHERE d.cid IS NOT NULL AND d.type_dx in(1,3) AND p.check_typearea IN(1,3) 
AND p.NATION IN(99) AND p.DISCHARGE IN(9)
AND substr(p.check_vhid,1,2) IN(@prov_c)
GROUP BY p.check_hosp,p.check_vhid
) b LEFT JOIN (
	SELECT
		f.hospcode,concat(h.provcode,h.distcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2) ,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode

		,COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid)) target
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.visit >1 , CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL)) visit2

		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(((f.ld_bp1 NOT BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d ) OR ISNULL(f.ld_bp1))
		,CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL )) no_bp
		
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.ld_bp1 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
		AND ((f.ld_bp2 NOT BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d) OR ISNULL(f.ld_bp2)) ,CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL )) bp1

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.ld_bp1 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
		AND f.ld_bp2 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d ,CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL )) bp2
		
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.ld_bp1 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
				AND f.sbp_1 <140 AND f.sbp_1 >=50 AND f.dbp_1 <90 AND f.dbp_1 >=50
				, CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL)) result_bp1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.ld_bp1 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
				AND f.ld_bp2 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d AND f.control_ht IN(1)
				, CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL)) result_bp2

  FROM
	t_chronicfu f INNER JOIN t_dmht d ON f.cid=d.cid 
	INNER JOIN chospital h ON f.hospcode=h.hoscode
	WHERE h.provcode in(@prov_c)  AND f.cid IS NOT NULL AND  d.type_dx in(1,3) AND d.NATION IN(99) 
	GROUP BY h.hoscode,areacode
) a ON b.hospcode = a.hospcode AND b.areacode=a.areacode
);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_ht_control 
(
SELECT 
	@id,f.hospcode,concat(h.provcode,h.distcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2) ,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
		,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
		,NULL,NULL,NULL
		,COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid)) target
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.ld_bp1 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
				AND f.ld_bp2 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d AND f.control_ht IN(1)
				, CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL)) result_bp2
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.ld_bp1 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
					AND f.ld_bp2 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d ,CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL )) bp2
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.visit >1 , CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL)) visit2
		,NULL
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(((f.ld_bp1 NOT BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d ) OR ISNULL(f.ld_bp1))
				,CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL )) no_bp
		,NULL
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.ld_bp1 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
					AND ((f.ld_bp2 NOT BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d) OR ISNULL(f.ld_bp2)) 
					,CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL )) bp1
		,NULL
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.ld_bp1 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
				AND f.sbp_1 <140 AND f.sbp_1 >=50 AND f.dbp_1 <90 AND f.dbp_1 >=50
				, CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL)) result_bp1
  FROM
	t_chronicfu f INNER JOIN t_dmht d ON f.cid=d.cid 
	INNER JOIN chospital h ON f.hospcode=h.hoscode
	WHERE h.provcode in(@prov_c)  AND f.cid IS NOT NULL AND  d.type_dx in(1,3) AND d.NATION IN(99) 
	GROUP BY h.hoscode,areacode
);

rows.indiv_sql:
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');
DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx  (
SELECT
h.hoscode hospcode, h.hosname, p.PID, p.CID, p.NAME, p.LNAME, p.SEX, p.BIRTH, p.HID, p.addr, p.check_vhid, p.NATION, p.TYPEAREA
,ROUND(d.rs_bps1) AS rs_bps1 , ROUND(d.rs_bpd1) AS rs_bpd1, d.ld_bp1, d.ih_bp1
,ROUND(d.rs_bps2) AS rs_bps2, ROUND(d.rs_bpd2) AS rs_bpd2 , d.ld_bp2, d.ih_bp2
,if(d.control_ht=1 AND  ld_bp1 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d ,'ควบคุมได้','ควบคุมไม่ได้' ) AS control
FROM
t_dmht d
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
INNER JOIN t_person_cid p ON d.CID = p.CID
WHERE d.CID IS NOT NULL AND d.type_dx in(1,3) AND p.check_typearea IN(1,3) 
AND p.NATION IN(99) AND p.DISCHARGE IN(9) 
);
SELECT
h.hoscode, h.hosname, d.PID, d.CID, d.NAME, d.LNAME, d.SEX, d.BIRTH, d.HID, d.addr, d.check_vhid, d.NATION, d.TYPEAREA
,d.rs_bps1, d.rs_bpd1, d.ld_bp1, d.ih_bp1
,d.rs_bps2, d.rs_bpd2, d.ld_bp2, d.ih_bp2
,d.control
FROM
tx d
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE  1=1 {where}

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code, h.zone_name as a_name, sum("target") as "target", sum("result") as "result_bp2", sum("bp") as "bp2", sum("bp1_d") as "bp1", sum("no_bp_d") as "no_bp", sum("result_bp1_d") as "result", sum("target1") as "target_f", sum("target2") as "visit2", sum("result1") as "result_bp2_f", sum("bp1") as "bp2_f", sum("bp1_f") as "bp1_f", sum("no_bp_f") as "no_bp_f", sum("result_bp1_f") as "result_f" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE ( h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) AND ( cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) GROUP BY h.zone_code, h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

service_plan.label: Service plan
service_plan.query: SELECT h.splevel as a_code ,h.splevel as a_name ,  sum(target) as target ,sum(result) as result_bp2 ,sum(bp) as bp2 ,sum(bp1_d) as bp1 ,sum(no_bp_d) as no_bp ,sum(result_bp1_d) as result  ,sum(target1) as target_f ,sum(target2) as visit2 ,sum(result1) as result_bp2_f  ,sum(bp1) as bp2_f  ,sum(bp1_f) as bp1_f ,sum(no_bp_f) as no_bp_f ,sum(result_bp1_f) as result_f  FROM (SELECT * FROM ccmihosp WHERE byear={{YEAR}}) as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hcode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} JOIN chospital as c ON c.hoscode = h.hcode WHERE (c.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (c.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (c.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (c.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (c.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (c.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (h.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CAST(regbed AS DECIMAL) DESC
